description: Keyword search across the AI Canvas icon set (React icons, four styles each: Line is free with an account; Duotone, Solid and Solid duotone are Premium). Matches on name, tags and category, best match first. Use when the user needs an icon ("a trash icon", "something for settings") or when building UI that needs icons. Then call `get_icon_install` with the chosen name and style.

category.description: Only icons in this category slug, e.g. "arrows", "ai-dev", "interface". Every result carries its category.

limit.description: Max number of matches to return. Default 20.

query.description: What the icon shows or is for, e.g. "delete", "arrow right", "ai agent".

name: search_icons
title: Search AI Canvas icons
